name: cera-platform
description: CERA Medical platform - public website, service catalogue, and controlled enquiry platform

scripts.//migrate: cera_app migrations are owned by @cera/db (ADR-009) and run once per deploy, before any app starts: two containers racing drizzle-kit against one database is a real failure mode. Payload (cera_cms) and Vendure (cera_commerce) own their own databases and add their own migrate steps here in phases 05 and 06.
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .next node_modules/.cache && rm -rf node_modules

//devDependencies: eslint and prettier are root dependencies because lint-staged resolves binaries from the root node_modules/.bin, not from the workspace a staged file happens to live in.
//lint-staged: The ESLint flag makes config resolution per-file rather than per-CWD. Without it, lint-staged runs from the repo root and every staged file is linted against the root eslint.config.js, ignoring each package's own config - so `pnpm lint` inside a package and the pre-commit hook disagree, and a file can pass CI and be blocked by the hook. The flag is ESLint 10's default behaviour, available in 9.x under this name; it comes out when the ESLint 10 hold in ADR-002 is lifted.

pnpm.//onlyBuiltDependencies: An explicit allow-list of packages permitted to run install scripts. Everything else is blocked, which is the supply-chain control reviewed in Phase 14. unrs-resolver is required: without its native binary, eslint-plugin-import-x cannot resolve TypeScript paths and every import rule silently stops working.
